description: Sources usable without registration for the vandalism extension (V0 audit 2026-11-16). Tar index = line number in mmaction2_demo/repo/tools/data/kinetics/label_map_k700.txt. SHA-256 of each archive is recorded in protocol.json on first download.

kinetics700_2020.license: annotations CC BY 4.0; videos remain owned by their YouTube uploaders (research use)
kinetics700_2020.decision: 2026-11-16: positives only smashing + breaking glass; graffiti/spray painting out of scope; tantrum and sledge hammer dropped

ashen_vandalism.decision: 2026-11-16: enabled as the only no-registration source with real kicking/tipping-over vandalism
ashen_vandalism.splits: splits_v2_native/{train,test}_anomaly_Vandalism.txt (+ train_normal.txt / test_normal.txt); list entries end in .npy -> use the .mp4 of the same stem
ashen_vandalism.temporal_annotation: splits_v2_native/Temporal_Anomaly_Annotation_for_Testing_Videos.txt (video label start1 end1 start2 end2, frame indices, -1 = absent)

positive.train_labels: video-level only -> multiple-instance (top-k windows), lower weight than Kinetics

negative.reason: same CCTV domain as the positives, so the model cannot learn 'CCTV look = vandalism'

hard_negative_optional.reason: fights must stay strike, not vandalism

charades.role: in-room hard negatives: ordinary throwing / handling objects at home
charades.access: 16.3 GB zip on S3; fetch only the needed members with HTTP range requests (remotezip), est. 3-4 GB
charades.extra: plus a random sample of other indoor segments (tidying, sitting, walking) as plain negatives
